newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH KB SAYS WINS MANDATE TO ARRANGE N.HUT LOAN.
newsitem.headline: CZECH KB SAYS WINS MANDATE TO ARRANGE N.HUT LOAN.

text.p: Komercni Banka a.s. (KB) on Friday signed a mandate agreement with steel maker Nova Hut a.s. , to arrange a 2.7 billion crown, 11-year syndicated loan, KB CEO Richard Salzmann told Reuters.
Salzmann said he expected the syndicate would be closed within three weeks.
"The syndicate will be comprised of two or three banks," he said. Salzmann would not elaborate on which would were expected to participate in the syndicate.
The loan comes on top of a $250 million credit package signed earlier on Friday with the International Finance Corp (IFC) and a syndicate of 17 international banks.
The IFC will provide a $75 million, 12-year loan to Nova Hut, while the syndicate will provide a $175 million, 10-year to help finance the constrction of a hot-rolled coil mill at Nova Hut.
Construction of the mill is being managed by U.S.-based ICF Kaiser International.

The total $650 million project is to completed by the year 2000, and will allow Nova hut to compete internationally as one of the low-cost steel producers of flat rather than long steel products which it traditionally had produced.
